sources.title: OpenAI API: Pricing, short and long context
sources.quote: Short context: ≤272K input tokens. Long context: >272K input tokens.

sources.title: OpenAI API: Pricing, GPT-5.6 Sol promotion
sources.quote: GPT-5.6 Sol’s promotional pricing is available until November 30, 2026.

sources.title: OpenAI API: Prompt caching guide, cache-write rates for GPT-5.6 and later
sources.quote: For GPT-5.6 and later, cache writes cost 1.25× the standard, uncached input-token rate for the default 30-minute lifetime. In the Responses API, you can choose a 12-hour minimum lifetime at a write rate of 2.5× ordinary input.

sources.title: OpenAI API: Prompt caching guide, summary of model differences (cache write charge)
sources.quote: Cache write charge | 1.25× for "30m"; 2.5× for "12h" in the Responses API | No additional cache-write charge | No additional cache-write charge

sources.title: OpenAI API: Prompt caching guide, cache-write pricing
sources.quote: Cache-write pricing is not an additive fee: input tokens use the uncached-input, cached-input, or cache-write rate.

sources.title: OpenAI API changelog, Oct 20, 2026 (12-hour prompt caching)
sources.quote: You can now choose 12-hour prompt caching in the API. 12-hour prompt caching keeps shared instructions, tools, and context cached longer to benefit from lower cached-input pricing, even when requests are hours apart. 12-hour cache writes cost 2.5x the input token price.

sources.title: OpenAI API changelog, Sep 29, 2026 (GPT-6.1 Sol released)
sources.quote: Standard pricing per 1M tokens for prompts with up to 272K input tokens is $2 input, $0.10 cached input, $2.50 cache write, and $10 output.

sources.title: OpenAI API changelog, Sep 22, 2026 (GPT-6 Sol released)
sources.quote: Standard pricing per 1M tokens for prompts with up to 272K input tokens: ... GPT-6 Sol: $2 input, $0.20 cached input, and $10 output. ... see pricing for cache writes, longer prompts, and other processing tiers.

sources.title: OpenAI API changelog, Sep 22, 2026 (GPT-6 Luna released)
sources.quote: Standard pricing per 1M tokens for prompts with up to 272K input tokens: ... GPT-6 Luna: $0.10 input, $0.01 cached input, and $0.50 output. ... see pricing for cache writes, longer prompts, and other processing tiers.

sources.title: OpenAI API changelog, Aug 21, 2026 (GPT-5.6 Sol price)
sources.quote: GPT-5.6 Sol now costs $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens, representing 20% lower input pricing and 33% lower output pricing. GPT-5.6 Sol’s promotional pricing is available at least through November 21, 2026.

sources.title: OpenAI API: gpt-6-astra model page, pricing notes
sources.quote: Prompts with more than 272K input tokens are priced at 2x input and cache rates and 1.5x output for the full request.

sources.title: OpenAI API: gpt-5.5 model page, pricing notes
sources.quote: For GPT-5.5, prompts with >272K input tokens are priced at 2x input and 1.5x output for the full session for standard, batch, and flex.

sources.title: OpenAI API: gpt-5.4 model page, pricing notes
sources.quote: For models with a 1.05M context window (GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.4 Pro), prompts with >272K input tokens are priced at 2x input and 1.5x output for the full session for standard, batch, and flex.

sources.title: OpenAI API deprecations, 2026-10-01: GPT-5.3-Codex, GPT-5.1, GPT-5.4-Nano
sources.quote: The following models are deprecated and will be removed from the API on April 1, 2027, with six months' notice.

sources.title: OpenAI API deprecations, 2026-06-11: GPT-5 and o3 model deprecations
sources.quote: On June 11, 2026, we notified developers using older GPT-5 and o3 model snapshots of their deprecation and removal from the API on December 11, 2026.

sources.title: OpenAI API deprecations, 2026-10-14: GPT-4 series model deprecations
sources.quote: On October 14, 2026, we notified developers using certain GPT-4 series models of their deprecation and removal from the API on January 14, 2027.
